body:
This PR does three main things:
- introduces flux accumulation for radiation and precipitation
- fixes a small bug where the sea-ice atmosphere fluxes did not account for the ice concentration (I flipped-flopped a lot on the convention but now it's stable in ClimaSeaIce, meaning we need per-ice not per-cell fluxes)
- corrects the scaling of temperature in sea-ice solver (I don't think this is the cause of the negative ice temperatures we see, I tried on this branch and we still get significantly negative temperatures)
- Ties the ocean step to the sea ice step and computes the sea-ice ocean fluxes independently of the coupler time step
title: Add correct flux accumulation and connect ocean and sea ice
